title: Chick waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='24' ry='22' fill='#FFD23F'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='20' ry='16' fill='#FFE066'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='38' r='20' fill='#FFD23F'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='38' r='20' fill='none' stroke='#FFE98A' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- belly fluff -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='13' ry='11' fill='#FFF3B0'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='35' r='3.6' fill='#2B2B4A'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='35' r='3.6' fill='#2B2B4A'/>
  <circle cx='44.3' cy='33.7' r='1.2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='58.3' cy='33.7' r='1.2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='37' cy='42' r='3' fill='#FF9A7A'/>
  <circle cx='63' cy='42' r='3' fill='#FF9A7A'/>
  <!-- beak -->
  <path d='M46 43 L50 50 L54 43 Z' fill='#FF8C2B'/>
  <!-- head tuft -->
  <path d='M50 18 Q47 10 52 6 Q51 13 56 16 Z' fill='#FFB84D'/>
  <!-- left wing (down) -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='64' rx='7' ry='11' fill='#F7C21F' transform='rotate(15 28 64)'/>
  <!-- right wing waving up -->
  <ellipse cx='73' cy='52' rx='7' ry='12' fill='#F7C21F' transform='rotate(35 73 52)'/>
  <ellipse cx='78' cy='44' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#FFD23F' transform='rotate(35 78 44)'/>
  <!-- motion lines near waving wing -->
  <path d='M82 36 Q86 32 84 27' stroke='#8FE3FF' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M87 42 Q92 39 91 33' stroke='#8FE3FF' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <path d='M40 86 L44 86 L42 82 Z' fill='#FF8C2B'/>
  <path d='M56 86 L60 86 L58 82 Z' fill='#FF8C2B'/>
  <path d='M36 87 L44 87 L40 84 L36 87 Z' fill='#FF8C2B'/>
  <path d='M56 87 L64 87 L60 84 L56 87 Z' fill='#FF8C2B'/>
</svg>
